d: Uttar pradesh ke mahrajganj sthit ghughli nagar panchayat men karoron ke 'dastabin skaim' ka bara khulasa huaa hai. sal 2018 men 100 litar kshamta vale 200 kuredan kharidne ka tendar nikala gaya tha. bajar men jinki kimat mahaj ₹2,400 se ₹3,400 ke bich thi, unhen sarkari khajane se ₹14,160 prati pis ke hisab se kharida gaya aur 2023 men ₹27.36 lakh ka bhugtan bhi kar diya gaya. samajsevi akhilesh maury ki shikayat aur EOW ki lanbi janch ke bad aktubar 2026 men purv va maujuda nagar panchayat adhyaksh samet 12 logon par FIR darj huee hai. dekhie is ghotale ki puri partal.
